sources.label: Zdrgon's Morphe Patches including Direct-to-Cell Satellite Data Optimization
sources.author: Zdrgon
patch_list: Required for re-signed builds: PairIP verifies the app's signing certificate at startup and kills the app if it isn't the Play signature. This disables that one check so the patched app can open.
Unlocks all premium features and removes ads by enabling the app's top donation tier state (the Dinner tier) — no purchase is made.
